children: JACK HENRY & ASSOCIATES INC reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $2.54B and diluted EPS of $6.98, with net income of $502.78M, reflecting year-over-year growth as the company continued shifting clients to cloud and digital services.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net Income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue growth of 7.1% was driven by cloud data processing, card fees, higher digital and transaction volumes, and faster payments.
Continued channel shift to private and public cloud hosting and rising Jack Henry digital active users strengthened recurring services.
Management reported a healthy sales pipeline with wins at larger financial institutions, supporting market share and cross-sell opportunities.
Operational investments increased in R&D, capital spending, and personnel to enhance products and cloud capabilities.
Strategic acquisition of Victor expanded Payments-as-a-Service and embedded payments via cloud-native APIs.
